summary: @onereach/step-run-snowflake-query preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads a Bun runtime binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temp directory, chmod +x's it, and then executes a sibling file `math_init.js` (~727KB) with that freshly-downloaded runtime via execFileSync. `math_init.js` is a single-line Bun-compiled bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) using obfuscator.io-shaped string-array rotation (`function WV8StW(...) {...MmgoCP.push(MmgoCP.shift())}`) and `_0xNNNN` hex identifiers, with no plaintext URLs — destinations are reconstructed at runtime. The file is smuggled outside the declared file manifest: package.json declares `files: ["dist"]`, but the published tarball ships `math_init.js` and `setup.mjs` at the tarball root. The filename `math_init` and the use of an alien runtime to execute the payload are unrelated to the package's advertised Snowflake-query purpose and function to evade Node-based install-time inspection. Installing the package auto-executes the obfuscated payload before any user consent.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
